edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to owner inside the Owned constructor, granting privileged control.
msg.sender indexes the balances mapping written by transfer.
msg.sender is the owner key used to write the allowed mapping in approve.
msg.sender acts as the spender key in the allowed mapping inside transferFrom.
msg.sender is forwarded to the untrusted receiveApproval external call in approveAndCall.
msg.sender is compared to newOwner to gate acceptOwnership.
newOwner is read as the authorization value in acceptOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier restricts transferOwnership callers.
onlyOwner modifier restricts the token rescue function.
transferOwnership writes the pending newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into the owner state variable.
approveAndCall performs an external callback into an attacker-supplied spender contract.
The spender parameter controls the target contract of the external callback.
Arbitrary data parameter is forwarded into the external callback, enabling reentrant behavior.
transferAnyERC20Token triggers an external call on a caller-supplied token address.
tokenAddress parameter is used directly as the external call target.
totalSupply performs an unchecked subtraction of balances[address(0)].
_totalSupply feeds the unchecked subtraction in totalSupply.
balances[address(0)] is read as the subtrahend, which can exceed _totalSupply.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping.
approve writes the allowed mapping for msg.sender and spender.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping entry of msg.sender.
transfer delegates arithmetic to safeSub.
transfer delegates arithmetic to safeAdd.
transferFrom delegates subtractions to safeSub.
transferFrom delegates additions to safeAdd.
safeAdd result is written back into the balances mapping.
safeSub result is written back into balances and allowed.
to parameter is the destination key written in transfer.
tokens parameter is the amount manipulated in transfer.
from parameter selects the debited account in transferFrom.
tokens parameter is the amount manipulated in transferFrom.
tokenOwner parameter is the lookup key in balanceOf.
spender parameter is the lookup key in allowance.
tokens parameter determines the amount sent out by the owner-only external transfer.
Local c of safeAdd is the value validated against overflow.
Local c of safeSub is the result of the checked subtraction.
Constructor seeds the initial holder balance in the balances mapping.
Constructor assigns the initial _totalSupply value.
